spec2def(ksuser.dll ksuser.spec ADD_IMPORTLIB)

# ksuser.dll is all Rust (ksuser-rust) and cargo links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/ksuser-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C stays on disk, uncompiled.
# The translated C, kept on disk:
# ksuser.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/ksuser-rust/src/ksuser/ksuser.rs)
# The C still compiled, in an OBJECT library whose compile the cargo link replays.
# Generated inputs those compiles read, ordered before them.
add_library(ksuser_shims OBJECT rust_cohab_stub.c)
target_link_libraries(ksuser_shims PRIVATE libadvapi32 libmsvcrt libkernel32 libntdll)
add_dependencies(ksuser_shims bugcodes)
add_cargo_module(ksuser ksuser-cargo ksuser.dll
    KIND win32dll
    BODY_CRATE ksuser-rust
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS ksuser_shims psdk)
